restaurantName: Xiu Ji Ikan Bilis Yong Tau Fu
address: Chinatown Complex Market & Food Centre, #02-87/88, 335 Smith Street, 050335, Singapore
bio: Since the 1960s, this shop has been selling Hakka-style minced fish-stuffed tofu in clear broth with fried anchovy. For a filling meal, add kway teow or rice vermicelli. Try the stuffed bitter gourd, aubergine or fish cake.
pageTitle: Xiu Ji Ikan Bilis Yong Tau Fu
